title: SGM Annotation
description: Structured metadata attached to a memory record. Normative structure for spec/annotations.md.

kind.description: Annotation type. Known kinds: rationale, status, state, as_of, source, confidence, what_i_did, next, blockers, files_touched, open_questions. Unknown kinds MUST be preserved.

value.description: The annotation payload. Usually a string; MAY be any JSON value.
